'''''Anthurium scherzerianum''''', the '''flamingo flower''' or '''pigtail plant''', is a species of ''[[Anthurium]]'' (family [[Araceae]]) native to [[Costa Rica]].<ref name="85334-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:85334-1 |title=''Anthurium scherzerianum'' Schott |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=27 September 2020 |archive-date=20 October 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191020194220/http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:85334-1 |url-status=live }}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]] as an ornamental houseplant, kept at {{cvt|15|C|F|round=5}} or higher.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Anthurium scherzerianum'' flamingo flower |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/1360/Anthurium-scherzerianum/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=27 September 2020 |quote=Other common names … jack-in-the-pulpit; painter's palette; Scherzer's flamingo plant; tail flower}}</ref> It is naturally an [[epiphyte]], growing on trees in the rainforest.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Flamingo plant (''Anthurium scherzerianum'') - JungleDragon |url=https://www.jungledragon.com/specie/6028/flamingo_plant.html |access-date=2021-06-18 |website=www.jungledragon.com |language=en}}</ref>

''Anthurium scherzerianum'' typically reaches {{cvt|12-18|in|cm|round=5|order=flip}} tall. Its most striking feature is its orange-red curly [[Spadix (botany)|spadix]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Flamingo Flower Plant - ''Anthurium scherzerianum'' |url=https://www.houseplantsexpert.com/flamingo-flower.html |access-date=2021-06-18 |website=www.houseplantsexpert.com |archive-date=2021-06-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624200316/https://www.houseplantsexpert.com/flamingo-flower.html |url-status=live }}</ref> It produces shiny, lance-shaped leaves about {{cvt|8|in|cm|order=flip}} long.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-04-28 |title=''Anthurium scherzerianum'' Best Care Tips Plant Care: A Helpful Guide |url=https://plantophiles.com/plant-care/anthurium-scherzerianum |access-date=2021-06-18 |website=plantophiles.com |language=en-US |archive-date=2021-06-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624204413/https://plantophiles.com/plant-care/anthurium-scherzerianum/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Common pests include [[Mealybug|mealybugs]], [[Aphid|aphids]], and [[Coccidae|soft scale]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Flamingo Flower (''Anthurium scherzerianu''m) - Plants {{!}} Candide Gardening |url=https://candidegardening.com/GB/plants/b60e6de1-b58c-48a2-b7fc-f368fb3a385d |access-date=2021-06-18 |website=Candide |language=en-GB |archive-date=2021-06-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624200022/https://candidegardening.com/GB/plants/b60e6de1-b58c-48a2-b7fc-f368fb3a385d |url-status=live }}</ref> When growing indoors, it needs bright indirect sunlight for 10 to 12 hours a day depending on the season. If the light is not bright enough, the number of flowers (flower density) will be diminished greatly. While often grown as a houseplant, it may be grown outdoors in the US in [[Hardiness zone|USDA hardiness zones]] 11 and 12.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Shoot |title=''Anthurium scherzerianum'' Flamingo flower Tail flower Jack-in-the-pulpit Painter's palette Scherzer's flamingo plant Care Plant Varieties & Pruning Advice |url=http://www.shootgardening.co.uk/plant/anthurium-scherzerianum |access-date=2021-06-18 |website=www.shootgardening.co.uk |language=en |archive-date=2021-06-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210627195643/https://www.shootgardening.co.uk/plant/anthurium-scherzerianum |url-status=live }}</ref>
